description: Byte-for-byte copies of upstream FAIR-bioHeaders data, vendored from tagged releases and pinned commits of the owning repositories. Never edited here: a new release or a moved draft means a new vendored file plus a provenance row, produced by tools/vendor_upstream.R and audited by tools/check_vendoring.R. The draft rows exist for the rule V7 opt-in lane only.
digests: SHA-256 of the exact bytes stored at `file`. The FAIR-bioHeaders file checksum is SHA-512/256 and is computed by this package's vendored core; SHA-256 here is the family's pinning digest for copied files, a different job.
commit_field: For released-contract rows this records the annotated tag OBJECT SHA of the ref (e.g. v0.6.0's tag object ab7e3ddd53bfccee9a31d59fc10524eadf32c1da, which dereferences to commit 0ae18b00ee4bd71ab2dc28bae706b0f9d195076b); byte identity was verified against the dereferenced tag. Draft rows record ordinary commit SHAs.

files.status: draft; no released contract, no schemaVersion, no registry row, no w3id URL
draft; FHGM is not a header type - these records are model records transported inside an FHGFF3 header under x-fhgm-models, and they carry no schema of their own

draft_vectors.status: Development vectors for the FHT 1.0 contract (FHT-Specification#8). No FHT schema is released and no installed toolkit reads FHT in its default path: every expected outcome is derived from the rule text, never from an implementation under test. Vectors marked promotion=candidate-unreviewed additionally await a second reader (see promotionCandidates).
draft_vectors.note: development vectors, not part of the 291; expectations derived from rule text upstream

draft_fhgm_vectors.not_vendored_note: paths relative to development/ in the owning repository: the upstream generator and checker scripts stay there, this package vendors data only
draft_fhgm_vectors.status: Draft FHGM conformance suite, prepared from the reviewed model contract. FHGM has no released contract, no schemaVersion, no schema URL and no schemas/versions.json entry, and selection rule V7 keeps it that way until the shared publication PR lands; nothing here publishes, adopts or claims support. Every outcome recorded below is an observation of development/model/validate_fhgm.py run against the base-schema bytes recorded in provenance.json, re-verified by run_conformance.py.
draft_fhgm_vectors.note: draft evidence, not part of the 291. Layers are recorded per vector: base (the released fhgff3.json contract over the parsed header), checksum, gff3 (a separate tool; every vector is recorded as accept) and model (the draft checker). This package reports base, checksum and the K1/K2 model layer natively; the checker's cross-record rules K3-K6 and the gff3 layer are not implemented here and their vectors are reported not-run with the rule named.
